title: Pasta with Quick Capsicum and Tomato Sauce
subtitle: made with jarred roasted capsicum
description: A quick upgrade to plain tomato pasta using a jar of roasted capsicums, crushed tomatoes and herbs.

steps.text: Drain the capsicums, slice into long strips and cut each strip into 3 pieces.
Meanwhile, cook the pasta in a large pot of well-salted water according to the packet instructions.

Take the capsicums out of the oil onto a separate plate, and add the tomatoes, chopped garlic, salt, sugar, thyme leaves and oregano to the pot. Do this after the capsicums so the oil takes on the flavour of the roasted capsicums.
Once the tomato sauce is boiling, return the capsicums with all their juices for another 2 minutes.
You can blend the sauce with a stick blender for a smooth, creamy sauce, or leave it as is. Either way, drain the pasta, add it to the sauce and mix.
